tagline: Flat signal-red slabs, black and white halves and a circle, square and triangle in the three primaries, set in uppercase Helvetica Neue Black with hard edges.

palette.description: red, black and white with yellow and blue only as small geometric accents

typography.style: uppercase black-weight Helvetica at 3:1 size contrast

best_for: Short, high-impact decks where whole-slide colour blocks do the talking: manifestos, exhibitions, identity pitches.
avoid_for: Dense reports or soft, personal stories; there are no gradients or rounded forms to soften the content.
name: Swiss Poster Blocks
